shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat rectangular panel
registers or horizontal bands dividing the surface
repeated small sign-like motifs in rows
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief profile animals and small human-like figures organised into horizontal registers, and both include a beaked bird, which is the most specific shared content. But B is dominated by dense rows of standardised script-like signs with two kneeling/adoring figures flanking the lowest register, whereas A shows large isolated figures — a fanged quadruped, a squatting figure, a plant-like motif and a big bird — plus a row of three-dimensional sculpted heads along the top, with no repeated sign system and quite different proportions and conventions.
